name: ibp-monorepo
description: IBP — Intent Based Programming: AI-assisted environment for building React websites.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ibp/webview build && pnpm --filter ibp build && pnpm --filter ibp-desktop build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/model-router && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/extension && tsc -p apps/extension/test && tsc -p apps/webview && tsc -p apps/desktop
